title: TDD Patterns
description: Learn common patterns for effective TDD.

data.text: **TDD patterns** provide strategies for writing tests effectively. They help you decide what to test and how to structure your tests.

items: Fake It – Return hardcoded values initially
Obvious Implementation – Write what you know
